An exciting opportunity exists for a motivated and detail-oriented Finance and Payroll Officer to join a highly respected, purpose-driven organisation making a genuine difference within the Australian community.

This is an opportunity to join an organisation with a strong social mission while working within a collaborative and supportive finance team environment where your work will directly contribute to meaningful outcomes.

This is a temporary role with a view to permanency and provides the opportunity to work within an organisation that combines commercial thinking with social impact.


Benefits

  • Temp to Perm opportunity | Immediate start available 
  • Work within a highly purpose-driven organisation making meaningful community impact
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Exposure across multiple finance functions with broad role scope
  • Strong organisational culture focused on collaboration and inclusion
  • Opportunity to work within a values-driven and mission-led environment
About the Role

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will play a critical role in supporting the delivery of accurate, timely, and compliant financial operations across the organisation.

This is a broad and hands-on role responsible for day-to-day transactional finance activities, payroll processing, reconciliations, and month-end support while partnering closely with stakeholders across finance, HR, and operational teams.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple priorities within a collaborative environment.

  • Process Accounts Payable invoices, payment runs, and supplier management

  • Perform daily bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
  • Support month-end, year-end, and audit processes
  • Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules
  • Assist with onboarding processes and support HR-related administration when required
  • Identify opportunities for system improvements and process efficiencies
  • Build strong relationships across internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Provide general finance and administration support as required


Requirements

  • Relevant experience within finance, payroll, accounting, or transactional finance environments
  • Strong understanding of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, payroll processing, and reconciliations
  • Exceptional attention to detail with high levels of accuracy
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working across finance systems
  • Experience using payroll systems and ERP systems will be highly regarded
  • Previous experience within not-for-profit, social enterprise, or multi-entity environments will be highly regarded
  • Positive, collaborative, and solutions-focused approach with strong alignment to purpose-driven environments

job.title: Marketing & Events Manager
job.description:
Marketing & Events Manager
Location: Melbourne (Hybrid)
Company: BROOK Recruitment
Type: Full-time (we would consider for 4-days)

About BROOK
BROOK is a growing, boutique recruitment agency specialising in corporate level recruitment. We pride ourselves on being a close-knit, high-performing team with a strong brand presence and a genuine focus on building long-term relationships with candidates and clients. As we continue to grow, we’re investing in our brand, community and events strategy to strengthen our market position.
We’re looking for a Marketing & Events Manager to take ownership of our marketing channels and lead the strategy, planning and delivery of our corporate events and networks.

The Role
This is a hands-on, end-to-end role for a proactive marketer who loves both strategy and execution. You’ll be responsible for managing BROOK’s owned marketing channels, building automated CRM journeys, and delivering high-quality corporate events that drive brand awareness, engagement and commercial outcomes.
You’ll work closely with the CEO, BD Manager and recruiters to position BROOK as a trusted authority in the recruitment market while creating memorable experiences for our community.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Brand
  • Own and manage BROOK’s owned channels including website, email marketing, social media and LinkedIn.
  • Develop and execute marketing campaigns to support recruitment, brand growth and new service launches.
  • Create engaging content using Canva and other tools to maintain a consistent, professional brand presence.
  • Manage website updates, landing pages, and basic SEO/content optimisation.
  • Build and maintain CRM automation workflows (e.g., email nurture journeys, candidate/client communications).
  • Analyse campaign performance and provide insights and recommendations for improvement.
Events & Community
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of BROOK’s corporate networking events and industry initiatives.
  • Develop event concepts, themes and formats aligned with business objectives.
  • Source and negotiate venues, suppliers, and event partners.
  • Identify, approach and secure speakers and panellists.
  • Manage event marketing, ticket sales, registrations and attendee communications.
  • Coordinate logistics on the day to ensure a seamless, high-quality experience.
  • Evaluate event performance and ROI, providing recommendations for future improvements.
About You
  • Proven B2B marketing experience, ideally in professional services, recruitment, consulting, or a related industry.
  • Proven experience across marketing channels (email, website, social media, LinkedIn).
  • Strong experience with CRM systems and marketing automation.
  • Confident using Canva (or similar tools) for content creation and brand assets.
  • Demonstrated experience managing events end-to-end, from ideation to delivery.
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to drive ticket sales, sponsorships and engagement.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, boutique environment where you’ll have ownership and autonomy.
Why Join BROOK?
  • Join a growing boutique recruitment agency with an ambitious vision.
  • Work with a close-knit, supportive and high-performing team.
  • Genuine ownership and influence over marketing and events strategy.
  • Opportunity to shape and grow BROOK’s brand and community presence.
  • Flexible, modern working environment. WFH Wednesdays, and finish early on Fridays.
How to Apply
